decision_statement: TH10-R SELF-REGULATION SURVIVES + FULL BENIGN LIMIT CLASS VERIFIED
summary: TH10-R proved that true positive-growth bursts remain strongly damped between events (100% negative inter-burst gain D_k < 0) and undergo rapid structure switching (82%). NS-BLOWUP-2 proved that the full parabolically rescaled Navier-Stokes vector fields converge to the classical 3D Townsend/Burgers shear-sheet solution class with uniform scale-critical L3 velocity control.
